$comment: Project-specific values for the SDLC loop. Every script under scripts/sdlc/, scripts/verify.mjs and .claude/hooks/ reads this file; nothing project-specific lives in them. Fill every field marked FILL.

commands.$comment: How a person or the journey-verifier agent starts the app locally, and the verify command name as CLAUDE.md quotes it.
commands.run: npm run build && node dist/transports/cli/cli.js serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3737   (MCP over HTTP plus the dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:3737; the CLI is node dist/transports/cli/cli.js <command>)

constraints: CONTRIBUTING.md (contributor contract: docs move with the change, version anchors, hook-change protocol, how a release is cut)
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (modules, data flow, storage, packaging; normative for structure)
docs/api/API_REFERENCE.md (the MCP / HTTP / CLI surface; normative for behaviour)
DESIGN.md (dashboard colour, type, spacing, interaction; read before any dashboard change)
AGENTS.md (the agent-facing product contract: the loop, the tools, hygiene)

verify.$comment: Run in order; the first steps are the fast local checks, `journeys: true` marks the steps CI reruns on every PR/MR (build + the suites that drive the running app). command `pnpm` becomes pnpm.cmd on Windows; `node` is the running Node binary.

steps.label: build (tsc, bundles, hook core, skills manifest, dashboard, smoke-test; regenerates the tracked dist/)
verify:release (lint, typecheck, version coherence, generated mirror, surface parity, doc claims, audits)
packaged artifact smoke (npm pack, install, run the CLI and doctor)
packaged dashboard e2e (Playwright Chromium against the real serve)

plan.$comment: A commit whose branch changes at least thresholdLines lines under sourcePrefixes (tests excluded) needs docs/plans/<slug>.md. Include the loop's own paths so it governs itself.

smoke.$comment: MeMesh has no public origin: the release is an npm publish. The receipt runs qa:post-release against the registry for the version package.json declared at the release sha (registry has it and it is `latest`; a fresh install from the registry runs it; the released artifact's own doctor passes). --skip-machine leaves the owner-machine surfaces to the owner, recorded as NOT RUN.

agent.$comment: Optional. Where the CI-run stages send model calls. Omit to use Anthropic through the claude CLI's credentials. baseUrl: any server speaking the Anthropic Messages API (e.g. a LiteLLM proxy in front of the DGX90 DeepSeek vLLM). authTokenEnv: name of the env var holding that server's token. models: per-stage model names that server expects (spec, plan, build, diagnose, review). Runners must be able to reach baseUrl (a private DGX needs a self-hosted runner on the same network).
